name: Just a Lighthouse
source:
You are sent to go work at a lighthouse. The Catalyst Research Center requires information from this mysterious place. Your job, keep the power on and record voices on the island. 

However there may be a mystery to uncover if you dig too deep.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/just-a-lighthouse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被派去灯塔工作。催化剂研究中心需要来自这个神秘地方的信息。你的工作就是保持岛上的电源接通并录制声音。

然而，如果你挖掘得太深，可能会发现一个谜团。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/just-a-lighthouse]Itch.io[/url]]
